objections: Names embedded in file names (e.g. underscore- or concatenation-joined payslip/medical-certificate names) are unlikely to be detected reliably as spans, so redact_text risks leaking employee names to a curious MSSP analyst holding the public staff list.

Even with the name removed, 'medical certificate' or payslip attachments tied to a recipient pseudonym disclose health/HR information the purpose does not need; no listed utility task (CYBER-U1..U11) uses attachment names, so suppress loses no required utility.
